key.name: accent-color-custom
key.description: Windows-style accent colour as '#rrggbb' (the colour shown on dark-mode fills; light mode uses a derived darker shade). Empty: follow org.gnome.desktop.interface accent-color.

key.name: accent-from-wallpaper
key.summary: Pick the accent colour from the wallpaper
key.description: Like Windows' "Automatic" accent: derive the accent from the dominant colour of the current wallpaper.
